subject.title: fix: require env resolution for web provider refs

question: Should unresolved env-style SecretRefs stop counting as configured web provider credentials for both web_search and web_fetch, even if existing configs depended on truthy ref strings?
rationale: The code fix matches the documented SecretRef contract, but it intentionally changes provider availability and fallback behavior for existing unresolved-env configurations.

options.title: Accept Stricter Env-Ref Semantics
options.body: Merge the centralized helper change and treat unresolved env refs as unavailable credentials while preserving literals, non-env refs, and provider auth fallback.

options.title: Ask For Caller-Level Upgrade Proof
options.body: Require focused web_search and web_fetch caller proof after rebase before accepting the behavior change.

options.title: Preserve Compatibility For Now
options.body: Pause this PR and choose a diagnostic-only or opt-in strict path if unresolved env refs must keep selecting providers during upgrade.

recommendation.title: Accept Stricter Env-Ref Semantics
recommendation.body: Merge the centralized helper change and treat unresolved env refs as unavailable credentials while preserving literals, non-env refs, and provider auth fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: The current helper extraction and PR assignment both point to steipete as the best available owner for the compatibility choice.
